stories.title: File Operation Resilience Contract and Error Schema
stories.description: Define a standard contract for local file operations including retry policy, error classification (transient vs fatal), fallback behavior, and response schema for all services performing disk I/O.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No standardized file I/O contract exists; GAP requires unified schema for resilience handling across services

stories.title: Retry and Backoff Engine for File Operations
stories.description: Implement core logic to automatically retry failed local disk operations using configurable retry limits and exponential backoff, handling transient errors such as file locks or temporary unavailability.

stories.title: Fallback and Safe Recovery Mechanism
stories.description: Implement fallback strategies for failed file operations including temporary storage, partial write recovery, and safe rollback to last known good state to prevent data corruption.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No existing fallback or recovery mechanism for local disk writes; GAP requires implementation of rollback and recovery handling

stories.title: Resilient File Operation Integration Layer
stories.description: Integrate resilience logic into existing services that perform file operations (e.g., pipelines, logging, manifest generation), ensuring all disk interactions use the retry and fallback framework.

stories.title: File Operation Resilience Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests simulating disk failures, partial writes, and recovery scenarios to validate retry logic, fallback execution, and data integrity guarantees.
